title: That ₹180 chai-and-snack stop adds up fast
description: A ₹180 chai-and-snack stop, 26 times a month, for 20 years, against the same money in a monthly SIP at an assumed 12% a year. Returns are assumptions, not assured. Illustrative only. Not financial advice.
